source: Harbor Hub leaderboard rows (server-rendered trial tables): https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/terminal-bench/terminal-bench/4/leaderboards/4-0-0/rows/<hub_row_id>?tab=results&page=1..4 ; leaderboard list: https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/terminal-bench/terminal-bench/4?tab=leaderboard
notes: Per-trial records scraped from the Hub's server-rendered leaderboard-row 'Trials' tab (anonymous GET, no API key; 100 trials/page, 4 pages per row; 140 page requests). passed = count of scored trials with reward >= 1 (rewards are binary 0/1; errored/failed trials count as reward 0, matching the Hub's 'avg reward'). All 35 configs have 66 tasks x 5 trials = 330 scored trials, attempt 1 only, no retries. Task names = repo tasks/ dirs at v4.0.0 (66/66 match). Validation: mean per-task pass rate matches the published accuracy to within rounding (<=0.05 pt) for 34/35 configs; exception: opus-5-claude-code-max reproduces 52.42% vs published 51.8% (~2 trials different; possibly trials re-scored/replaced after the leaderboard aggregate was computed). Muse Spark 1.3 has 5 trials with status 'failed' (counted as 0). Grok 4.7's '(partial: 324/330)' on the leaderboard refers to cost reporting; all 330 trials have rewards. Config fields repro_* are the reproduced numbers; hub_row_id identifies the Hub row. Data is live and may change if submissions are added or re-scored.
